partners.title: Suppliers
partners.createDescription: Supplier codes are stored in uppercase.

items.title: Items & BOM
items.description: Manage raw materials and finished goods, and set the material quantity per finished unit (BOM).
items.createDescription: Register a BOM with a finished good so work orders can calculate planned material usage.
items.bomHint: Raw material required to make one finished unit

receipts.title: Material Receipts
receipts.description: Registering a receipt issues an internal LOT and updates inventory and the transaction ledger.
receipts.supplierLotHint: LOT no. on the supplier's certificate (optional)
receipts.searchPlaceholder: Receipt no., LOT, part no., supplier

workOrders.title: Work Orders
workOrders.description: Create work orders for finished goods; planned material usage is calculated from the BOM.
workOrders.selectItemFirst: Select a finished good to see planned usage.
workOrders.searchPlaceholder: Work order no., part no., name
workOrders.noResultYet: No production result has been confirmed yet.
workOrders.salesOrderHint: Selecting a sales order fills in the item and quantity.
workOrders.equipmentHint: Equipment under breakdown or maintenance cannot be assigned.

production.title: Production Results
production.description: Select a work order, enter good/defect quantities and actual usage per material LOT, then confirm.
production.selectWorkOrder: Select a work order from the list on the left.
production.noOpenWorkOrders: There are no planned work orders.
production.willIssueLot: On confirmation, a finished LOT of {{qty}} good units will be issued.
production.noFinishedLotHint: No finished LOT is issued when the good quantity is 0.
production.noLots: No LOTs with stock are available.
production.confirmDescription: The result below will be confirmed and inventory updated.
production.irreversible: Cancelling or correcting a confirmed result is not supported in this version.
production.approvalHint: Inventory is updated when a manager approves.
production.directHint: Inventory is updated immediately on confirmation.
production.requestDescription: Approval will be requested with the details below. Stock is re-checked when it is approved.
production.approvalNote: Inventory does not change until approval.
production.requestedNote: When a manager approves it in the inbox, the result, material issue and finished-goods receipt are processed in one transaction.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.description: Stock on hand by item and LOT, and the receipt/production/shipment ledger.

lotTrace.title: LOT Traceability
lotTrace.description: Trace a finished LOT back to its work order, production result, input material LOTs and original receipts.
lotTrace.empty: Enter a LOT number to trace.

shortage.title: Entered quantity exceeds the LOT's stock on hand.
shortage.note: If stock is insufficient, nothing is saved — no result, stock change or ledger entry.

salesOrders.title: Sales Orders
salesOrders.description: Register customer orders and track their work orders and shipments.

shipments.title: Shipments
shipments.description: Select a sales order and enter the ship quantity per finished LOT. Shipping deducts finished-goods stock.
shipments.selectOrder: Select a sales order to ship.
shipments.noLots: No finished-goods stock available to ship.
shipments.shortageNote: If stock is insufficient, nothing is saved — no shipment, stock change or ledger entry.
shipments.searchPlaceholder: Shipment no., order no., customer, LOT

approvals.description: Review and approve or reject production result approvals. Approval runs the confirmation transaction.
approvals.selectHint: Select a document from the list on the left.
approvals.shortageNote: Not processed because stock was insufficient at approval time. The request stays pending.
approvals.noPermission: Only managers or administrators can approve or reject. Try switching the user in the header.

equipment.title: Equipment
equipment.description: Register equipment and manage its status (running, idle, maintenance, breakdown) and inspection/repair history.
equipment.createDescription: Equipment codes are stored in uppercase.

users.title: Users
users.description: Manage users and roles (operator, manager, administrator). Only managers and administrators can approve.
users.createDescription: Demo user — switched from the header without logging in.
